problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimization of convex differentiable components and their convex average on a real Hilbert space; strong convexity is not required.
problem_class.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ReshuffledSmoothConvex.lean: Params and spec.admissible, component ConvexOn clause.

problem_class.label: finite_sum
problem_class.details: The objective is f(x)=n⁻¹∑ᵢ fᵢ(x), with n≥1.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: Every reply is an exact component gradient for every call index and seed; there is no additive, relative, biased, or stochastic oracle error.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: A query supplies a component index i and point x and receives ∇fᵢ(x). Each such evaluation counts as one oracle call.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ReshuffledSmoothConvex.lean: spec.Query, spec.Reply and spec.admissible; LongTails/Template.lean: execute and Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: At an objective minimizer x*, n⁻¹∑ᵢ‖∇fᵢ(x*)‖²≤σ². This bounds component heterogeneity at the minimizer, not oracle noise or variance uniformly over x.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Component smoothness constants ℓᵢ are nonnegative, satisfy ℓᵢ≤Lmax and n⁻¹∑ᵢℓᵢ≤Lavg, and globally bound gradient Lipschitz continuity. A minimizer satisfies ‖x0−x*‖≤R. All Params are public, including n, Lavg, Lmax, R, σ, ε and x0; ℓᵢ and x* are existential witnesses. Validity requires 0<Lavg≤Lmax, R≥0, σ≥0 and ε>0. E is a complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure, without a finite-dimensional restriction. Allowed algorithms belong to the family specified by reshuffledGradient.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/ReshuffledSmoothConvex.lean: Params; spec.Public, publicInput, valid, admissible and allowedAlgorithm.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return one E-valued measurable point X with integrable objective gap f(X)−f(x*) and expected gap at most ε.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: The guarantee is ∫[f(X)−f(x*)] dP≤ε under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law. The oracle-call budget is fixed and holds for every seed.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex finite-sum minimization with exact component gradients, variance at a minimizer, and expected objective-gap accuracy is an established optimization benchmark. Separate component smoothness bounds and a Hilbert-space formulation refine this standard setup.

descriptionHtml:
Random Reshuffling for Convex Minimization

We consider minimizing F(x)=n−1∑i=1nfi(x) on a real Hilbert space E, where n≥1 and the functions fi:E→R are differentiable and convex. Their gradient Lipschitz constants have prescribed average and maximum bounds. A global minimizer x⋆ satisfies prescribed bounds on its distance from the given starting point x0∈E and on the mean squared component-gradient norm there. The oracle returns ∇fi(x) at (i,x). Random reshuffling uses independent uniform permutations for a chosen number of epochs, then the identity order. For ε>0, its final iterate x¯ must satisfy EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε, where P is the law of these permutations.

The optimization problem is minx∈EF(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E. The parameters satisfy 0<Lavg≤Lmax,R≥0,σ≥0,ε>0. The algorithm receives E, n, Lavg, Lmax, R, σ, ε, and x0; the component functions are accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Component convexity and smoothness). Each fi is Fréchet differentiable on E, and for every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], fi((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)fi(x)+tfi(y). There exist constants ℓ1,…,ℓn such that 0≤ℓi≤Lmax,i=1,…,n,1n∑i=1nℓi≤Lavg,∥∇fi(x)−∇fi(y)∥≤ℓi∥x−y∥,x,y∈E.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance and gradients at a minimizer). There exists x⋆∈E such that F(x⋆)≤F(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R,1n∑i=1n∥∇fi(x⋆)∥2≤σ2.

Our result is algorithm-specific: we analyze random reshuffling with a constant step size within each epoch. The algorithm chooses an integer K≥0 and a deterministic sequence (ηk)k≥0 of real step sizes from its inputs. The setup imposes no sign or magnitude restriction on ηk. For k=0,…,K−1, let πk be independent uniform permutations of {1,…,n}; for k≥K, set πk to the identity. Starting from the given x0, the iterates satisfy xkn+j+1=xkn+j−ηk∇fπk(j+1)(xkn+j),k≥0,0≤j<n. Queries may use any component index and any point in E. Each update uses one component-gradient query. After an allotted number T≥0 of queries, the output is the last iterate x¯=xT, including when T ends within an epoch.

The output must be measurable, its objective gap must be integrable under P, and it must satisfy EP[F(x¯)−F(x⋆)]≤ε.

comparisonHtml:
Let f=n−1∑i=1nfi on a real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure, n≥1. Each fi is convex with ℓi-Lipschitz gradient, 0≤ℓi≤Lmax and n−1∑iℓi≤Lavg, where 0<Lavg≤Lmax. A minimizer x⋆ satisfies ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R and n−1∑i∥∇fi(x⋆)∥2≤σ2, with R,σ≥0. The oracle returns exact component gradients. The setup restricts algorithms to RR; (1) uses fresh independent uniform permutations and a known-horizon linearly decreasing epoch step. Its measurable last iterate has integrable gap and satisfies ∫[f(xnK(ω))−f(x⋆)]dP(ω)≤ε, ε>0, under the permutation law P.

import LongTails.Template
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Perm.Basic
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.BorelSpace.Basic

namespace OracleTemplate.ReshuffledConvex

def Orders (n K : ℕ) := Fin K → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)

instance (n K : ℕ) : Fintype (Orders n K) := inferInstanceAs (Fintype (Fin K → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)))
instance (n K : ℕ) : Nonempty (Orders n K) := ⟨fun _ => Equiv.refl _⟩
instance (n K : ℕ) : MeasurableSpace (Orders n K) := ⊤
instance (n K : ℕ) : MeasurableSingletonClass (Orders n K) := ⟨fun _ => trivial⟩

def schedule {n K : ℕ} (orders : Orders n K) (k : ℕ) : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) :=
  if h : k < K then orders ⟨k, h⟩ else Equiv.refl _

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

noncomputable def reshuffledGradient {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (K : ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (x0 : E) :
    Algorithm (Fin n × E) E E where
  Seed := Orders n K
  law := ⟨(PMF.uniformOfFintype (Orders n K)).toMeasure, inferInstance⟩
  State := (ℕ → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) × ℕ × E
  initial orders := (schedule orders, 0, x0)
  query s := (0, (s.1 (s.2.1 / n) ⟨s.2.1 % n, Nat.mod_lt s.2.1 (NeZero.pos n)⟩, s.2.2))
  update s g := (s.1, s.2.1 + 1, s.2.2 - η (s.2.1 / n) • g)
  output s := s.2.2

end OracleTemplate.ReshuffledConvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.ReshuffledSmoothConvex

open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.ReshuffledConvex

structure Params where
  E : Type u
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  n : ℕ
  [nonzero : NeZero n]
  Lavg : ℝ
  Lmax : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE Params.measurableE
  Params.borelE Params.nonzero

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := Fin p.n → p.E → ℝ
  Query p := Fin p.n × p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  allowedAlgorithm q algorithm :=
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ), algorithm = reshuffledGradient K η q.x0
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.Lavg ∧ q.Lavg ≤ q.Lmax ∧ 0 ≤ q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 < q.ε
  admissible q f oracle :=
    (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (f i)) ∧
    (∀ k seed i x, HasGradientAt (f i) (oracle.answer k (0, (i, x)) seed) x) ∧
    (∃ ℓ : Fin q.n → ℝ, (∀ i, 0 ≤ ℓ i) ∧ (∀ i, ℓ i ≤ q.Lmax) ∧
      (q.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ℓ i ≤ q.Lavg ∧
      ∀ i x y, ‖gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y‖ ≤ ℓ i * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn (LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R ∧
      (q.n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ‖gradient (f i) xstar‖ ^ 2 ≤ q.σ ^ 2)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧
    ∃ xstar, IsMinOn (LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f) Set.univ xstar ∧
      Integrable (fun ω => LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f (output ω) - LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f xstar)
        (P : Measure _) ∧
      (∫ ω, LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f (output ω) - LongTails.Setups.FiniteSumSmoothAndConvex.objective f xstar ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.ε

end LongTails.Setups.ReshuffledSmoothConvex
